item.title: Jetboat Sights and Adventures: Come Join the Extradimensional Fun!
item.content:encoded:
A shortish draft regarding jetboats, alternate dimensions, and corporate espionage.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Man, it's been a long long while since I've written a draft! After 8 months of sitting at a computer screen staring at a blank page, I've managed to create something to be critted on! For the kind of crit I'm looking for, tone, SpaG errors, writing style, and enjoyability of the article are main ones I'm looking for!

Link to the draft is here: http://firedawnfolder.wikidot.com/pen-26

If you have any other kinds of crit, that's also welcome!

item.title: The Click
item.description: Do you ever just click with someone?
item.content:encoded:
http://scp-sandbox-3.wikidot.com/oystershell

Draft is available under "The Click" tab.

I feel kind of bad posting this while my other draft is up for critique, but the rules say I can, so I'm going for it. I had the idea for this skip this morning and spent all day today writing it in a haze. I've proofread, but errors are likely. Let me know!

Specific points of critique I'm looking for help with:

Dialogue. It's not my strong suit and there's a lot of it. Does it work? Does it resonate emotionally? If not, how to proceed.

Should the very end be removed? I feel like the final monologue could be stupid and/or too revelatory. If so, how to proceed.

Thanks for your time.

item.title: SCP-5921-EX "The Melonheads"
item.description: A draft I have based on the concept of "melonheads" in my home state.
item.content:encoded:
Hello, my name is C or Agrimony, and I have a draft for you. I have submitted a few other drafts for review in my time and they have usually come to mixed reviews, although one was an official article for *ahem* several days before being deleted for unpopularity. However, I have a draft for review that I think is pretty satisfactory, as I based it on actual folklore (urban legends) and thus had a pretty firm foundation to build upon. Please give feedback on how I can improve, and enjoy! Thank you!

The draft is here: SCP-5921-EX

item.title: A Closer Examination of SCP-173
item.description: Some conclusions about 173, based on common sense and cross-test results (2009 words).
item.content:encoded:
This is an essay written by a researcher studying SCP-173, summarizing his conclusions based on what we know and can reasonably figure, and some hypotheses based on what he thinks. Neatly summarizes various cross-test results involving 173 and adds a little of my own interpretation. My biggest concern is that this concept will fail to deliver anything new enough to be interesting about the most-written-about skip on the site.

First tab of my sandbox.

item.title: Kamikaze mosquitoes
item.description: A weird species of mosquitoes (3k draft), any crit welcome.
item.content:encoded:
The title is a bit self-explanatory but this is a draft about weird mosquitoes that for a few reasons decide to fly into their target and die. This is a rough and weird draft at the moment.

Any amount and type of crit is welcome. Clinical, SP&G, dialogue/narrative etc. I definitely need some eyes on it. I have a tendency to overcomplicate things and I think it also shows/brings down the draft a bit. I don't think I can pull off the concept without a lot of feedback.

The narrative and dialogue are pretty low quality in my opinion (definitely not the standard for the wiki). If I can't seem to get it right after a lot of attempts I think it might be better to change these out with a table with incident logs or something.
